news.title: Morocco U17 Women Qualify for World Cup Round of 16
news.lede: Rabat – Morocco’s U17 women’s national team have officially qualified for the Round of 16 of the 2026 FIFA U17 Women’s World Cup, which is being hosted by Morocco. The Atlas Lionesses secured their place in the knockout stage after guaranteeing a finish among the four best third-placed teams in the group stage. Morocco qualified with a goal difference of -2, finishing ahead of Venezuela and Canada, who collected the same number of points but recorded inferior goal differences of -3 and -5, respectively. The qualification marks another step for Morocco’s young players in the global competition, which brings together some of the best emerging talents in women’s football.

news.title: Ghana U15 thrash Uzbekistan 4-1 in World Cup Festival opener
news.lede: Abdul Aziz Issah and Jerry Owusu scored twice each to secure all three points for Ghana, who impressively began their campaign in Baku. Ghana took control of the contest from the opening whistle, showing attacking intent and composure against their Asian opponents. Aziz Issah led the scoring with a brace before Owusu added two goals to put the game beyond Uzbekistan's reach. Uzbekistan managed a consolation goal late in the match, but Ghana held on to claim a comfortable victory and make an early statement in the competition.

news.title: Ghana U-15s Thrash Uzbekistan 4-1 in FIFA World Cup and Festival Opener
news.lede: Ghana’s National U-15 Boys team made an impressive start to the FIFA U-15 World Cup and Festival with a commanding 4-1 victory over Uzbekistan in their opening Group W fixture in Azerbaijan on Saturday. Abdul Aziz Issah and Jerry Owusu were the stars of the encounter, scoring twice each to inspire the Black Comets to a convincing win and announce their intentions in the competition. The emphatic result gives Ghana a strong foundation as they continue their group-stage campaign, with the young talents looking to build on their impressive opening performance. The Black Comets face Myanmar and Guam on Sunday before rounding off their group-stage fixtures against the Bahamas and Kazakhstan on Monday.

news.title: U-17 Women’s World Cup 2026: How Nigeria ending North Korea’s 18-match unbeaten run can inspire African women’s football
news.lede: Nigeria’s 3–1 victory over defending champions DPR Korea did more than secure a place in the Round of 16 on Friday. It ended an extraordinary unbeaten run and reminded Africa that its young footballers can challenge the world’s most accomplished teams. Nigeria’s Flamingos did not just defeat the defending champions at the FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup in Morocco. They brought an end to a remarkable run of dominance and delivered a statement that should resonate across African women’s football.
